description_expanded: Come, stay, and play at Stealing Happy Hours, a beautiful pet-friendly home located in Navarre! You and your whole crew will enjoy a  fabulous getaway in this spacious retreat near restaurants, shopping, and plenty of family-friendly adventures! Stealing Happy Hours is a delightful, modern home with four bedrooms and three baths, the 3rd bath is a half bath, accommodating up to 11. Beautifully furnished and fully appointed, this stunning home boasts spacious rooms with thoughtful details, sure to make you feel right at home. Cozy furnishings and a flat-screen TV in the living room encourage relaxing afternoons while watching your favorite movies and shows. Even the chef in the group can join in the fun while preparing coastal creations in the kitchen. You’ll find tons of counter and cabinet space, and the breakfast bar is a great gathering spot for delicious home-away-from-home meals. Dine indoors, fire up the grill, and take it outside to the furnished sunroom overlooking the private saltwater pool. The fenced-in yard offers plenty of privacy for you, your family, and your furry companions!  Bedrooms offer the perfect ending to perfect beach days, and cheerful bathrooms are equipped with modern amenities, ensuring comfort and relaxation during your stay. Unwind in the master suite with a king-sized bed, large flat-screen TV, and private access to the sunroom and pool. The en-suite bathroom features double sinks, a shower, and a garden tub, the perfect spot for an evening soak. With a queen-sized bed, a double bed, and two twin beds in the guest suites, your whole crew can enjoy blissful sleep every night of your stay. An electric fireplace in the living room and a full-sized washer and dryer are additional conveniences to enjoy during your stay! Although you’ll more than likely want to hang out by the pool all day long, don’t forget that you’re near lots of fun activities as well as the beach! Whether grabbing breakfast at Alphy’s, enjoying lunch at Dewey Destin’s, or catching the sunset at Juana’s Pagodas, you’ll find delicious seafood at every turn. Hit the shops in downtown Navarre, explore the Santa Rosa Sound on paddle boards, or spend the afternoon at the Gulf Breeze Zoo, all just minutes away! NOTE: 2 dogs under 50 pounds are permitted, but dogs are not allowed in the pool. The non-refundable pet fee is an additional $300 fee. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
